NFRA forms panel on audit quality, technology, and AI

The National Financial Reporting Authority (NFRA) has established a nine-member advisory panel focused on audit quality, assurance, and technology. The panel comprises experts from professional, regulatory, technology, and industry sectors. Its mandate is to advise the audit oversight authority on emerging challenges and risks, including those related to Artificial Intelligence (AI).
